status.en: 31 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 35% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Sweida.
status.nb: 31 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 35 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Sweida.

summary.en: Jordan resumed airstrikes in southern Syria against Daesh, prompting Syrian condemnation and reports of civilian casualties. Syrian security forces killed a French jihadist in Harem and another French fighter in Idlib, while unidentified gunmen killed two Syrian defence ministry personnel in Idlib. Flash floods across Syria killed five people, including four children, and injured several others. Syria announced the release of 57 prisoners transferred from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Jordan gjenopptok luftangrep i sørlige Syria mot IS, noe som førte til syrisk fordømmelse og rapporter om sivile tap. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker drepte en fransk jihadist i Harem og en annen fransk fighter i Idlib, mens uidentifiserte skytere drepte to ansatte i det syriske forsvarsdepartementet i Idlib. Flomskader over hele Syria førte til fem døde, blant dem fire barn, og flere ble såret. Syria kunngjorde løslatelse av 57 fanger overført fra Libanon. UCDP registrerte 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
